settings.centre_tol_source: the task's allowed overlap at the contact (default)

pad_contact.calibration: sphere of the object's mass on a plane under the leader's g

derivation.stations_at_surface_note: share of the contacts whose station lies on the object's surface (sink = the whole pad radius): a leader that recorded contact points, not pad centres, for which this stiffness is force over the pad radius
derivation.derivation: median over the leader's contacts of force / (pad radius + object radius - |station - centre|), the leader's recorded station positions and forces

leader.source: assumed: the leader carries no gravity entry, so gravity is taken along -z in its frame (checked against its net contact force)

no_load_speed.source: Allegro V4 max joint speed (reseller page)

path_jumps.note: rates are the stored joint change over the leader step between checked frames (follow's continuity readout); the replay drives them as stored

track.note: the kinematic drive sets the path exactly; not run

settings.pad_radius_source: Wave_manip sim/run_wave_unified.py finger_geom_radius, the leader's mocap finger spheres
settings.station_servo_source: Wave_manip unified_v6/bridge/server.py SCENE_DEFAULTS servo_kp, station_mass, force_limit; critically damped (servo_kv None); the leader itself used mocap stations, which cannot turn an object here
settings.leader_station_surface_distance_note: median |station - object centre| - R while on; the pad radius less the leader's own penetration
settings.friction: MuJoCo contact friction mu (condim 3) in place of the leader's analytic kernel; its stations were condim 1
settings.integrator_source: Wave_manip sim/run_wave_unified.py integrator="implicit" at timestep 0.002; the station servo is unstable under Euler at that step (STATION_INTEGRATOR)
